methods.name: createApplication
methods.desc: Create the contract with initial configuration

methods.name: transferAdmin
methods.desc: Transfer admin to new address (admin only)

methods.name: registerNode
methods.desc:
Register a node with P2P ID
Requires payment transaction for stake + MBR for box storage

methods.name: addStake
methods.desc:
Add additional stake to existing registration
Requires payment transaction

methods.name: withdrawStake
methods.desc:
Withdraw stake
Can withdraw to minimum or full amount (which deregisters)

methods.name: heartbeat
methods.desc: Heartbeat to prove node is alive and update uptime

methods.name: banNode
methods.desc: Ban a node and slash stake (admin only)

methods.name: isNodeActive
methods.desc: Check if node is active (registered and recently sent heartbeat)

methods.name: getNodeByIndex
methods.desc: Get node address by index (for discovery/enumeration)

methods.name: getP2pIdOwner
methods.desc: Get owner of a P2P ID (for reverse lookups)
